In this video, Firstpost explains how a powerful Thanksgiving 2026 storm threatens millions across America with 60 mph winds, power outages, flash floods and travel chaos. More than 20 states face severe weather, while the iconic Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade could also be disrupted. Gursshheen Gahllen brings you the details on Firstpost America.
